text: 72 Second edition Additional management issues in the treatment of drug-resistant TB Additional management issues in the treatment DR-TB include the following: l HIV-positive children with DR-TB should also receive: - pyridoxine (5-10 mg/kg per day); - CPT; - ART, which markedly improves treatment outcome and should be initiated as early as possible. l The use of corticosteroids as for drug-susceptible TB and for IRIS. l Nutritional support measures are especially important for children with DR-TB. l Infection control measures are crucial to prevent the spread of DR-TB. l Adherence is critical to prevent further development of resistance.
